No source recovery; validators only reject candidates. Raw facts and accepted facts are separate. Exact-field scoring is not clinical validation. Development results are not held-out results. Dataset role and description: Second development trial: evidence-first medication output, explicit current-source boundary, and clearer follow-up versus appointment prompts. Used for prompt selection; not held out.
